text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why? The voices around me... and my limiter isn't even holding me back anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm running all on my own,
this isn't fun at all...!
choice_data_list: Even so, you're still gonna run, right?
Even so, you're still going to run, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm running all on my own,
this isn't fun at all...!
choice_data_list: Even so, you're still gonna run, right?
Even so, you're still going to run, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...My mind's made up.
I've already made my choice."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter how many times I lose.
No matter how uncool it looks, I'll keep going until I win...!
choice_data_list: You're properly holding on to that tenacity
You're holding on tightly to that tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You get it, don't ya?
That's right, I wanna win."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just because I want to.
Because I want to keep running...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Are you not enjoying it? Do you want to stop?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No way, absolutely not!
You know that too, don't you!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Losing is frustrating and makes you mad.
But that's what racing is all about.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"This is the race I chose.
So I'm definitely not quitting!"
choice_data_list: Then there's only one thing left to do.
Then there's only one thing left to do.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, let's do a debriefing.
We're gonna review every single race I've lost so far.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna look lame running, but...
just crossing the finish line isn't enough for me anymore!
